title: Restore independent FNV oracle in shared vector generator
description: test/vectors/generate.py advertises independent CCP hash oracles but imports hash_32 from lichen.sim.tdma (which reexports production timing code) for hop/channel vector generation. A production hash regression can therefore regenerate matching incorrect expected outputs. Replace the import with a literal local FNV-1a32 oracle, pin it against published constants, and regenerate only affected CCP families deterministically.
